The '''16th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2005 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2004, were held on January 22, 2005.<ref>{{cite web|agency=Associated Press|title='Aviator' takes top Producers Guild award|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-jan-24-et-pga24-story.html|website=Los Angeles Times|access-date=August 27, 2017|date=January 24, 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151212223449/http://articles.latimes.com/2005/jan/24/entertainment/et-pga24|archive-date=December 12, 2015|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Producers Guild Awards Honorees|url=http://thefutoncritic.com/news/2005/01/05/producers-guild-awards-honorees-17498/20050105pga01/|website=thefutoncritic.com|accessdate=August 27, 2017|date=January 5, 2005}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Producers Guild Awards 2005 |url=http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2005.asp |publisher=Producers Guild of America |accessdate=April 10, 2020 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20081215034915/http://www.producersguild.org/pg/awards_a/awards2005.asp |archivedate=December 15, 2008 |url-status=dead}}</ref> The ceremony at [[Culver Studios]] in [[Los Angeles, California]] was hosted by [[Wayne Brady]].<ref>{{cite news|title='The Aviator' Receives Top Award From Producers Guild of America|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-jan-23-me-awards23-story.html|access-date=September 21, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 23, 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150927230717/http://articles.latimes.com/2005/jan/23/local/me-awards23|archive-date=September 27, 2015|url-status=live}}</ref> The nominees were announced on January 5, 2005.<ref>{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title=Producers' '04 nominees|url= https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-jan-06-wk-quick6.3-story.html|access-date=April 8, 2023|work=Los Angeles Times|date=January 6, 2005|archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20230408082037/https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2005-jan-06-wk-quick6.3-story.html |archive-date=April
